stat: Share of UK businesses with 10 or more employees already running a large language model day to day, expressed as a business count
method: Recipe B (sector/population cut from an aggregate) — applying a published adoption percentage to a published business population count, a total neither source publishes itself

sources_used.title: Artificial intelligence in UK businesses: 2023 to 2026
Business population estimates for the UK and regions 2024: statistical release

workings: ONS reports that large language models were the most widely used AI technology among UK businesses with 10+ employees in June 2026, at 18% adoption. DBT's 2024 business population estimates give approximately 211,000 businesses with 10-49 employees, 37,800 with 50-249, and 8,250 with 250+, summing to 257,050 businesses with 10 or more employees. 257,050 x 0.18 = 46,269, rounded to approximately 46,000. Caveat: this joins a June 2026 survey figure to a 2024 population count; the combined total is a Tom & Co estimate, not a figure either source publishes.
